1.consolidated_definition: beb. Recipiente metálico donde se mezclan los componentes de un coctel. Usual. DRAE 2001. Con sólo presionar un botón, la coctelera forma un ciclón en su interior mezclado tu bebida favorita. Esta fabricada con acrílico transparente y acero inoxidable; funciona con 2 pilas “AA” incluidas (Solo Stocks, consultado 19-09-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Shaker (n.) 

Container made of metal where the components of a cocktail are mixed. Usual. Formed by pressing a button, the shaker creates a cyclone inside, mixing your favorite drink. It is manufactured with transparent acrylic and stainless steel; it operates on 2 included "AA" batteries.
